**Heads up: the database schema moves to v12. Upgrading keeps all your data, but going back to an older version requires clearing app data, because old builds cannot read the new schema**

- Tap the folder title at the top left of the media library to switch paths quickly
- Stop the same folder from appearing twice after a refresh or when another app opens a video with a differently cased path
- Show video resolution and file size as one line of subtle text, in the same order everywhere
- Give folders a rounded plate with a folder glyph, no longer clipped in grid layout
- Refuse folder moves into the folder itself or one of its subfolders, so files never get scrambled
- Keep favorites and playlist entries pointing at the new location after a folder move
- Stop a folder move from leaving two entries for the same folder
- Drop videos whose files are already gone when you pull to refresh
- Speed up pull to refresh and moving folders that hold many videos

- 点击媒体库左上角的目录标题，可以快速切换路径
- 修复下拉刷新或从其他应用打开视频后，同一个文件夹因路径大小写不一致而在主页显示两次的问题
- 改用一行浅色小字显示视频的分辨率和文件大小，各页面顺序统一
- 换成圆角底板配文件夹图标的缩略图，网格布局下不再被裁切
- 拒绝把文件夹移到它自己或它的子目录里，避免文件被移乱
- 移动文件夹后让收藏和播放列表跟着指向新位置
- 修复移动文件夹后同一个文件夹在主页留下两条记录的问题
- 下拉刷新时清掉文件已经被删除的视频记录
- 加快下拉刷新和移动大量视频文件夹的速度
